description: This is an abstract base class for action models in a widget framework, part of the OFBiz project. It handles creation and execution of various widget actions such as setting fields, invoking services, executing scripts, and querying entities, based on XML configuration.

classes.name: EntityAnd
classes.description: Represents the <entity-and> XML element which performs a query with multiple conditions using a logical AND.

classes.name: EntityCondition
classes.description: Models the <entity-condition> element for querying entities based on specified conditions.

classes.name: EntityOne
classes.description: Represents the <entity-one> element for querying a single entity by primary key.

classes.name: GetRelated
classes.description: Models the <get-related> element to retrieve related entities based on a relationship.

classes.name: GetRelatedOne
classes.description: Models the <get-related-one> element for retrieving a single related entity.

classes.name: PropertyMap
classes.description: Handles the <property-map> element, expanding resource bundles into a map.

classes.name: PropertyToField
classes.description: Represents the <property-to-field> element, assigning properties to widget fields with optional type conversion.

classes.name: Script
classes.description: Models the <script> element, which executes external scripts or mini-lang methods.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents the <service> element, enabling invocation of a service with mapped input and output handling.

classes.name: SetField
classes.description: Models the <set> element, setting widget fields based on various input sources including defaults, other fields, or session/application attributes.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new ModelAction instance based on the XML element's node name.

methods.name: readSubActions
methods.description: Reads and parses sub-actions from XML parent element into a list of ModelAction instances.

methods.name: runSubActions
methods.description: Executes a list of ModelAction instances with the provided context.
